_readme: Source of truth for /referrals, one page per offer (/referrals/<id>), one page per category (/referrals/<category id>), /referrals.json and the 'Referral codes' section of llms.txt. Edit this file, then run: node _build/build.js. Only publish:true entries appear anywhere; entries past 'expires' (YYYY-MM-DD) are skipped. 'asOf' labels bonus amounts in forYou. 'note' adds a line to the card. 'headline' is a short, factual hook for the offer page's title (keep it under 30 characters, or leave it out). 'logo' is a site path to the company's icon (128px PNG in images/referrals/). Categories: 'titleLead' starts the category page title, 'h1' is [plain text, emphasised text] for its heading, 'intro' is its opening line. --check warns when lastVerified is more than 60 days old.

categories.label: Credit cards
categories.intro: Referral links for credit cards. Each bank sets the welcome bonus and decides on approval, and the current offer is always on its own application page.

categories.label: Investing & trading
categories.intro: Referral codes and links for investing, crypto and trading apps. Each platform sets its own sign-up reward, rewards change often, and investing carries risk.

categories.label: Payments
categories.intro: Referral codes and links for payment apps in the US and in India, including apps for paying credit card bills.

categories.label: Send money to India
categories.titleLead: Send Money to India Referral Codes
categories.intro: Referral codes and links for apps that send money to India. Compare the first-transfer bonus with the fees and the exchange rate, since the bonus is only part of what you get.

categories.label: Shopping & cash back
categories.intro: Referral codes and links for cash back sites and apps in the US and in India. You earn cash back when you shop or buy gas through them.
